questions.hint: The new array must be filled from the old one.

options.text: Arrays.copyOfRange(row, 2, 3)
options.misconception: believes the first index names the last column

questions.explanation: copyOfRange copies the half-open interval from index 1 up to but not including 3, so it copies indices 1 and 2 into a fresh length-2 array, {5, 6}. The exclusive end is the trap, and reaching for copyOf instead is the natural guess because the two names rhyme, but copyOf's second argument is a new length, so copyOf(row, 1, 3) does not even compile.
questions.hint: The second index itself is not part of the result.
